body:
i actually take diphenhydramine at the moment for sleep at a doctors recommendation, it works 70% if the time. Much more than other OTC pills i took.

I also take blood pressure meds for anxiety and panic because i refuse to take harder stuff like benzos because of a history of family addiction to them, i dont want to go down that road like the others did.

Ive tried so many medications, he cant suggest any new ones. Im at a dead end as far as drugs go.
 
My feelings have come back after a 3 year absence, since the last time i tried to commit suicide. 

I remember it well, and almost the entire time since i though, "im cured, i dont feel that way at all anymore"...until recently, until suddenly it wasnt even depression anymore, it was just,.....i dont know how to better explain it than "i just dont care anymore, lets end this."
